54/G.goal: Explain how VR resource optimization is grounded in client-side computer-graphics rendering, from XR resource definitions to raster-display image synthesis.
54/G.achieves: It equips the learner to recognize the client-side display and rendering resources that shape VR system requirements and later optimization decisions.

54/O1.goal: Explain the scope of VR resource optimization in terms of XR resources, the need to optimize them, and the focus on client-side hardware.
54/O1.achieves: It positions the later computer-graphics content as a way to understand the client-side constraints that drive XR system design.

54/O2.goal: Explain the basic computer-graphics problem underlying VR resource optimization by describing image representation and synthesis for interactive experiences.
54/O2.achieves: It prepares the learner to connect VR resource needs to graphics rendering work before examining display systems.

54/O3.goal: Describe how a generic graphics system renders a color image on a commercial raster-scan display.
54/O3.achieves: It gives the learner the display and rendering foundations needed to identify client-side VR resource requirements before studying optimization techniques.
